stories.title: Define malpractice UI schema and rendering contract
stories.description: Define frontend data contract for malpractice measure display including fields: status (clean/flagged/unknown), case_count (optional), last_incident_date (optional), state_board_url, and score_contribution. Ensure compatibility with MessageBubble.tsx rendering pipeline and markdown-safe output.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx (rendering pipeline); GAP: no malpractice UI schema exists

stories.title: Implement malpractice display logic and labeling rules
stories.description: Implement logic to map backend malpractice measure to UI display states: clean vs flagged vs unknown. Enforce wording rules: never use terms like fraud or misconduct; display neutral signal language. Calculate and format contribution to overall provider score.
stories.evidence: Feature requirement: neutral signal-only display; GAP: no existing malpractice interpretation logic

stories.title: Render malpractice section in provider scorecard UI
stories.description: Create UI component within provider scorecard to display malpractice status, icon (clean/flagged), link to state medical board, and score contribution. Ensure links are validated and rendered safely via markdown pipeline.

stories.title: Integrate malpractice data into API response and UI binding
stories.description: Bind malpractice measure data from backend response into frontend component, ensuring correct parsing, null handling, and graceful fallback when data is missing. Validate end-to-end flow from facade to UI.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py (provider detail orchestration); GAP: malpractice field not yet exposed

stories.title: End-to-end tests for malpractice display and wording compliance
stories.description: Create tests validating: correct display states (clean/flagged), presence of state board link, accurate score contribution rendering, and strict enforcement of neutral language (no prohibited terms like fraud). Include UI snapshot or rendering tests.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests (existing test patterns); sprint_plan/uat_library (UAT scenarios); GAP: no malpractice UX tests exist
